thread:
rory_am: FYI the customer POC just hit a bunch of 429s during the live demo. They said generation calls were fine for 1-2 minutes then every request started failing. can we swarm? :eyes:
ben_infra: tagging infra. do you have a sample request/headers or a log snippet? rate-limit headers would be ideal.
maya_se: saw the logs they pasted into the sales ticket — includes these headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 120`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Reset: 1753001280`, `Retry-After: 30`. looks like a per-route cap plus burst exhausted.
alex_sales: customer worried about bursting affecting demo. also asking if raising quota costs extra.
ben_infra: quick notes — Redwood has three layered limits: global account quota, per-route caps, and short-term burst windows. if X-RateLimit-Remaining is 0 and Retry-After present, they hit a configured per-route burst.
nashley_ops: quick triage checklist: 1) confirm client concurrency (are they opening many parallel streams?), 2) check client retry/backoff, 3) confirm token budget per-minute for that workspace, 4) see if route uses larger model (bigger token cost) which can shorten budget.
rory_am: client used parallelism of 12 concurrent streams in the demo. they expected streaming responses to be fast.
maya_se: that concurrency + long outputs will exhaust per-minute token budget and trigger per-route caps. suggest increasing route cap for the POC or lowering concurrent connections.
ben_infra: I can bump per-route cap from 120rpm to 300rpm for the demo workspace temporarily. note: billing is usage-based — more tokens = higher invoice. tell them we can set a soft cap to automatically drop to slower throughput once a token threshold reached.
alex_sales: customer says they'd rather not increase budget mid-demo. any mitigation without quota change?
nashley_ops: implement immediate client-side mitigations: - reduce concurrency from 12 -> 3 - add exponential backoff on 429s (start 500ms, cap 5s) - enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts - shorten max_tokens on generation requests
ben_infra: pushed a short-term tweak: increased burst window and added 2x temporary per-route cap for workspace poc-006. watch headers; should see X-RateLimit-Remaining > 0 now.
infra-bot: [auto] quota-change: user=poc-006, route=chat.generate, old_cap=120rpm, new_cap=240rpm, changed_by=ben_infra, ts=1753002205
maya_se: client retry worked and demo resumed but still occasional spikes to 429 when multiple long streams start simultaneously.
rory_am: customer asked for an explanation they can show internal security/ops — need a short one-paragraph summary about why 429s happen and why our mitigation is safe.
ben_infra: suggested copy: "429s occur when the configured rate or token budget for a route is exceeded. This protects service stability by enforcing predictable throughput. Mitigations include temporary cap increases for POCs, controlling client concurrency, enabling caching, and applying exponential backoff on retries. All changes are auditable in the console and can be reverted after the POC."
alex_sales: thanks. also client asked: will increasing cap expose them to noisy neighbors?
maya_se: not for POC — per-workspace routing keeps their traffic isolated. Dedicated capacity would be required for strict isolation.
nashley_ops: created a quick runbook snippet for the SEs: ```
- If 429s: capture X-RateLimit-* headers
- Reduce client concurrency to <=4
- Add backoff: retry-after header or exponential backoff
- Consider temporary per-route cap increase via Console -> Projects -> <workspace> -> Quotas
- Monitor token burn in Console (Tokens/min and per-route breakdown)
```
rory_am: sending the runbook + one-paragraph to the customer now. great work everyone :tada:
ben_infra: follow-up: I'll schedule a post-mortem with infra if we see repeated 429s after POC when traffic normalizes.
infra-bot: [auto] note: quota bump will auto-revert in 72h unless marked persistent (use `redwood console quotas set --persist`).
alex_sales: client confirmed demo good now, wants best practice doc. can someone drop a short set of recommendations into the sales playbook?
maya_se: putting a short checklist into /docs/sales/poc-rate-limits.md and will ping the channel when done.
rory_am: closing the swarm. thanks team. :heart:
